description: Mada hii inatoa utangulizi wa ushairi: maana ya ushairi, tofauti kati ya ushairi wa kimapokeo na ushairi huru, bahari za ushairi, vipengele vya ushairi wa kimapokeo kama vina, mizani, mishororo, beti na kibwagizo, pamoja na dhima ya ushairi.

options.text: Ni utungo wa kisanaa wenye mpangilio wa maneno wenye mahadhi na hisia
Ni hadithi ndefu ya kubuni iliyoandikwa kwa nathari
Ni mazungumzo ya kawaida ya watu wawili
Ni orodha ya maneno yasiyo na maana

mcq.explanation: Poetry (ushairi) is an artistic composition with an arrangement of words carrying rhythm and emotion.

mcq.questionText: Mstari mmoja katika ubeti wa shairi huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: A single line within a stanza is called a mshororo (verse line).

mcq.questionText: Idadi ya silabi katika mshororo wa shairi huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: Mizani refers to the number of syllables in a line of poetry.

mcq.questionText: Sauti zinazofanana mwishoni mwa mishororo ya shairi huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: Vina are the matching end-sounds (rhymes) at the end of poetic lines.

mcq.questionText: Mshororo unaojirudia mwishoni mwa kila ubeti huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: A kibwagizo is the refrain line that repeats at the end of each stanza.

mcq.questionText: Aina ya ushairi usiozingatia sheria za vina na mizani huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: Free verse (ushairi huru) does not follow the rules of rhyme and meter.

mcq.questionText: Katika mshororo "Mama anapika chakula", idadi ya mizani (silabi) ni ngapi?
mcq.explanation: Each syllable is one mizani: Ma(1) ma(2) a(3) na(4) pi(5) ka(6) cha(7) ku(8) la(9), giving nine mizani in the line.

mcq.questionText: Ushairi wa kimapokeo hutofautiana vipi na ushairi huru?

options.text: Ushairi wa kimapokeo hufuata kanuni za vina na mizani, ushairi huru haufuati
Ushairi wa kimapokeo hauna beti, ushairi huru una beti
Ushairi huru huandikwa kwa nathari tu

mcq.explanation: Traditional poetry obeys rules of rhyme (vina) and meter (mizani), while free verse does not.

mcq.questionText: Sehemu inayoundwa na mkusanyiko wa mishororo katika shairi huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: A stanza (ubeti) is a group of verse lines (mishororo) forming a section of a poem.

mcq.questionText: Shairi lenye mishororo minne katika kila ubeti huitwa bahari gani?
mcq.explanation: Tarbia is a poetic form (bahari) in which each stanza has four lines.

mcq.questionText: Shairi lenye mishororo mitatu katika kila ubeti huitwa bahari gani?
mcq.explanation: Tathlitha is the form in which each stanza contains three lines.

mcq.questionText: Ipi kati ya zifuatazo ni dhima ya ushairi katika jamii?

options.text: Kuelimisha, kuonya, kuburudisha na kuhifadhi utamaduni

mcq.explanation: Poetry serves to educate, warn, entertain, and preserve culture in society.

mcq.questionText: Katika ushairi wa kimapokeo, mshororo mara nyingi hugawanywa katika sehemu mbili. Sehemu hizo huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: A line is often split into two halves called vipande (ukwapi and utao).

mcq.questionText: Sehemu ya kwanza ya mshororo (kabla ya kituo) huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: The first half of a line is the ukwapi; the second half is the utao.
A poet is called mtunzi wa mashairi or malenga.

tf.questionText: Ushairi wa kimapokeo hufuata kanuni za vina na mizani.
tf.explanation: Traditional poetry strictly follows rules of rhyme and meter.

tf.questionText: Ushairi huru lazima uwe na idadi sawa ya mizani katika kila mshororo.
tf.explanation: Free verse does not require equal syllable counts; that is a feature of traditional poetry.

tf.questionText: Kibwagizo ni mshororo unaojirudia mwishoni mwa kila ubeti.
tf.explanation: The kibwagizo is the recurring refrain at the end of each stanza.

tf.questionText: Mizani ni sauti zinazofanana mwishoni mwa mishororo.
tf.explanation: Those matching end-sounds are vina; mizani are syllable counts.

tf.questionText: Ubeti huundwa na mkusanyiko wa mishororo.
tf.explanation: A stanza is made up of several lines (mishororo).

tf.questionText: Dhima mojawapo ya ushairi ni kuelimisha na kuonya jamii.
tf.explanation: Poetry educates and warns the community, among other roles.

tf.questionText: Tarbia ni bahari ya shairi yenye mishororo mitatu katika kila ubeti.
tf.explanation: Tarbia has four lines per stanza; the three-line form is tathlitha.

tf.questionText: Mtunzi wa mashairi pia huitwa malenga.
tf.explanation: A poet may be referred to as a malenga.

tf.questionText: Ushairi huru ni sawa kabisa na nathari kwa sababu hauna mahadhi wala hisia.
tf.explanation: Free verse still carries rhythm, imagery, and emotion that distinguish it from ordinary prose.

tf.questionText: Mshororo katika ushairi wa kimapokeo unaweza kugawanywa katika vipande viwili.
tf.explanation: A traditional line is often divided into two vipande: ukwapi and utao.

hoq.questionText: Tazama ubeti huu wa mfano: "Soma kwa bidii sana, / Elimu ni taa yetu, / Ujinga tuuondoe, / Maisha yawe matamu." Ni kipengele gani cha kishairi kinachoonekana mwishoni mwa mishororo (sana, yetu, ondoe, tamu)?
hoq.explanation: The matching sounds at the line ends are the end-rhymes (vina vya mwisho).

hoq.questionText: Mtunzi anataka kutunga shairi la malalamiko ya wakulima bila kufungwa na sheria za vina na mizani ili kueleza hisia kwa uhuru. Ni aina gani ya ushairi inayofaa zaidi na kwa nini?

options.text: Ushairi huru, kwa sababu hauwekewi vikwazo vya vina na mizani na huruhusu uhuru wa kueleza hisia
Ushairi wa kimapokeo, kwa sababu unahitaji vina na mizani sawa
Tarbia, kwa sababu ni lazima iwe na mishororo minne
Takhmisa, kwa sababu ina mishororo mitano tu

hoq.explanation: Free verse (ushairi huru) suits the goal because it is not bound by rhyme and meter, allowing freer expression of feeling.

hoq.questionText: Katika ubeti wenye mishororo minne ambapo mshororo wa mwisho unajirudia katika kila ubeti, vipengele viwili vinavyodhihirika ni vipi?

options.text: Ushairi huru na vina vya kati

hoq.explanation: Four lines per stanza indicate the tarbia form, and a repeating final line is the kibwagizo (refrain).
